# Jeremy Collins

Jeremy Collins is a senior software engineer at Webflow in Los Angeles. He works on growth engineering: billing, usage metering, paywalls, and customer-facing product. He previously worked at MasterClass, HitRecord, Plink, and Event Farm. He studied at the University of California, Davis.

Outside of work he makes independent software for iOS and the web. No ads, tracking, or paywall.

## Codable

Codable is a free iOS app with Safari-native web developer tools. Inspect HTML, styles, network requests, and console output. Also includes a scratchpad and viewport tester. Available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/codable/id1324741659

Privacy policy: https://jeremycollins.net/codable-privacy-policy

## Taktung

Taktung is a free iOS app for Vercel deploy and incident ops. See site health and the latest deploy, then promote or roll back after you confirm. A Vercel token stays on the phone. Not affiliated with Vercel. Available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/taktung/id6805738660

Privacy policy: https://jeremycollins.net/taktung-privacy-policy

## Codeatrophy

Codeatrophy is a set of interactive tutorials on web development fundamentals (algorithms, system design, CS), built with React Native for iOS, Android, and web: https://codeatrophy.vercel.app/
